note: Mandated en→es terminology for all Sage EHS Spanish content (docs/i18n/PIPELINE.md). Authored from app-surface mining, corrected through 5-lens adversarial review (evidence: docs/i18n/review/glossary.json). Safety-agnostic scope per owner directive 2026-07-07.
registerRules: Usted en todo momento; nunca tú ni vosotros — 'escanee', jamás 'escanea' ni 'escanead'.
Instrucciones y advertencias al trabajador en imperativo de usted: 'No opere', 'Evacúe', 'Detenga el trabajo'.
Botones y menús en infinitivo (convención es-419: 'Enviar', 'Emitir permiso'); el imperativo de usted queda para instrucciones y alarmas.
Nivel de lectura ≤ 6.º grado: frases cortas (≈15 palabras máx.), voz activa, una acción por frase, cero jerga legal.

Español latinoamericano neutro; prohibidas formas ibéricas: coger, vosotros, ordenador, gafas, cualificado, fallo, caducado, monitorización, EPI, bombona, barandilla, carretilla elevadora, consignación, ficha de datos de seguridad.

Prohibido slang de un solo país: troca, plática, casquillo, patín hidráulico, reflejante (MX); zorra, matafuego, autoelevador, barbijo (AR); grúa horquilla, mantención (CL); malogrado (PE); espejuelos (Caribe).

Terminología anclada a materiales oficiales de OSHA en español cuando existen: bloqueo y etiquetado (LOTO), espacio confinado, arnés, andamio, persona competente, EPP, protección contra caídas, montacargas, resbalones/tropiezos/caídas.
Nunca suavizar lenguaje de seguridad: sin diminutivos, sin condicionales ('debería'), sin cortesía en alarmas — 'EVACÚE', no 'por favor salga cuando pueda'.
hazard = peligro; risk = riesgo; severity = gravedad. Nunca intercambiarlos ni usar 'severidad'.
PPE → EPP siempre; 'respirador' nunca 'mascarilla'; 'casi accidente' nunca 'no pasó nada'.
Los acrónimos de doNotTranslate se conservan; expanda en español solo la primera vez: 'bloqueo y etiquetado (LOTO)', 'hoja de datos de seguridad (SDS)'.

Plataforma agnóstica de industria (directiva del dueño): vocabulario general de lugar de trabajo (planta, almacén, taller, patio, sitio), nunca marco exclusivo de construcción; 'cuadrilla' para crew — 'equipo' queda reservado para máquinas.
Números como en los medidores y en OSHA-es: punto decimal (19.5 %); símbolos O₂, CO, H₂S, LEL sin traducir.
Textos de alarma en MAYÚSCULAS permanecen en mayúsculas: EVACÚE, DETENGA EL TRABAJO, NO ENTRE, NO OPERE, FUERA DE SERVICIO, NO USE.
Un solo término mandatado por concepto en toda la interfaz; los sinónimos regionales aceptados viven solo en notas o capacitación oral, nunca en la UI.
doNotTranslate: NIOSH, ANSI, NFPA, ASTM, ISO (organization names)
Regulatory citations / regRef strings verbatim (e.g. 29 CFR 1910.147, 1910.146, 1910.178, 1926.501, T8 CCR §3203, NFPA 51B, ANSI Z358.1)
Equipment IDs, makes, model and serial numbers (e.g. FL-04, itemNumber values, Toyota 8FBE20, S/N)
Kept acronyms — expand in Spanish once, then keep: LOTO, JHA, PTP, SDS, LEL, IDLH, SCBA, MEWP, SRL, PM, DRI, IIPP
Gas symbols and chemical formulas: O₂, CO, H₂S, CO₂, ppm
N/A (expand once as 'no aplica', keep the glyph)
Units as printed on devices/labels: %, °F/°C, psi, kN, lb/kg
EHS (functional brand acronym — never expand, never substitute HSE/SSOMA)
PFAS (fall arrest only in this app — never bare: always paired with its Spanish expansion 'sistema personal de detención de caídas', see entry)

entries.note: OSHA-es pub 3151 official term. Banner 'PPE REQUIRED' renders 'SE REQUIERE EPP'. Expand once, then use EPP.
OSHA-es 'casco de protección/seguridad' (29 CFR 1910.135); DESIGN.md anchor hard hat→casco. Short 'casco' OK in space-tight checklist rows.
forbidden: gorra (bump cap — not impact-rated, unsafe downgrade)

entries.note: OSHA-es materials alternate gafas/anteojos; 'lentes de seguridad' is the pan-LatAm shop-floor term. One mandated term per concept.
OSHA-es PPE materials. Welding shield is 'careta de soldar' (see Welding PPE entry).
OSHA-es 1910.95 hearing conservation. Hazard 'Noise' = 'ruido'. Name tapones/orejeras only when the specific type matters.
forbidden: cascos (Spain: earmuffs — collides with hard hat)
tapones (one type only, not the category)

entries.note: ANSI/ISEA 107 class references stay as-is. 'Alta visibilidad' understood by all nationalities.
forbidden: chaleco fluorescente (a property, not the rating)

entries.es: botas con punta de acero o compuesta
entries.note: OSHA-es protective footwear (1910.136, ASTM F2413). 'Punta' is the neutral term for the toe cap.
Plain 6th-grade phrasing; ANSI cut levels (A1–A9) stay untranslated.
forbidden: guantes a prueba de cortes (overclaim — no glove is cut-proof)
guantes de carnaza (Mexicanism, one leather type)

entries.es: EPP de soldadura (ropa protectora, guantes y careta)
entries.note: 'Careta de soldar' = welding helmet/shield, the pan-LatAm term. 'Ropa protectora' is garment-agnostic: every jacket word is single-country (chamarra MX, campera AR, casaca PE) and 'chaqueta' is vulgar slang in Mexico. Covers candidates welding gloves + welding jacket/shield.
forbidden: chaqueta (vulgar slang in MX — breaks regional neutrality and register)
lentes oscuros (sunglasses are NOT welding protection — unsafe)

entries.note: OSHA-es 1910.134 'protección respiratoria; respiradores'. A respirator is certified PPE; a surgical mask is not.
OSHA-es anchor 'arnés'; only a full-body harness may arrest a fall (1926.502).
forbidden: cinturón de seguridad (body belt — prohibited for fall arrest since 1998; also reads as seatbelt)

entries.en: Personal fall arrest system (PFAS: harness + lanyard/SRL + anchor)
entries.es: sistema personal de detención de caídas
entries.note: OSHA-es official (1926.502). In this app PFAS = fall arrest, never the chemical family; keep the acronym only next to the Spanish expansion.

entries.es: eslinga de seguridad / línea de vida autorretráctil (SRL)
entries.note: OSHA-es materials use 'cuerda/cinta de seguridad (lanyard)'; field variants abound. UI standardizes the FULL 'eslinga de seguridad' — never bare 'eslinga', which reads as a load-rated lifting/rigging sling. Keep SRL acronym after expansion.
forbidden: eslinga (bare — reads as a load-rated rigging/lifting sling, never person-rated fall protection)

entries.note: NIOSH/OSHA-es 'aparato/equipo de respiración autónoma'. SCBA supplies breathing AIR.
forbidden: tanque de oxígeno (SCBA uses air, not oxygen — dangerous myth)

entries.note: OSHA/ISO distinction: hazard = source of harm; risk = probability x severity. Never interchange (JhaForm, HazardTable).
Counterpart of 'peligro'; used in 'nivel de riesgo', 'riesgo residual'.
OSHA-es fall-protection materials. Safety-agnostic platform: state no single trigger height in copy (varies 4 ft/6 ft by sector).
Standard signage form ('riesgo de caída de objetos').
OSHA-es machine-safety materials use 'puntos de pellizco'; 'aplastamiento' covers crush.
'Izaje' is the pan-LatAm rigging term. Instruction form: 'Nunca se pare debajo de una carga suspendida.'
OSHA-es electrical materials. 'Partes vivas' (live parts) appears in electrical codes — accepted synonym in notes, UI standardizes 'energizadas'.

OSHA-es 1910.252 / NFPA 51B-es official term. 'Incendio' keeps the plain fire hazard (flammable storage, battery charging) visible in the hazard list — the platform is safety-agnostic, not hot-work-only.
forbidden: trabajo caluroso (hot weather, not hot work)

entries.note: OSHA-es official (1910.146; pub 3138-es 'Espacios confinados que requieren permiso'). Mandated anchor term.
forbidden: espacio cerrado (understates — not every closed space is confined)

entries.note: 'Manejo manual de cargas' is the LatAm regulatory phrasing (e.g. MX NOM-036).
OSHA-es standard triad in walking-working-surfaces materials.
Hazard-table row; pairs with 'protección auditiva' (1910.95).
forbidden: sonido (alone, as the hazard label — understates the hazard; OK inside 'prueba de sonido')

entries.note: OSHA-es 'sílice cristalina respirable' (1926.1153/1910.1053). Welding fumes = 'humos de soldadura'. Fumes are NOT 'vapores'.
OSHA-es heat campaign 'Agua. Descanso. Sombra.' uses 'enfermedades por calor'. 'Golpe de calor' = heat stroke, the emergency subtype only.
Plain form; covers hydraulic, pneumatic, steam. Release energy before work (see LOTO).
'Filoso' is pan-LatAm (RAE marks it Am.); 'cortante' acceptable in prose.
PTP hazard row; plain phrasing for pedestrian/traffic exposure.

entries.es: inmersión o sepultamiento en líquidos o material a granel
entries.note: Confined-space hazard (1910.146): being surrounded/buried by liquids or flowable solids (grain, sand). Plain gloss for crews: 'quedar sepultado o sumergido'. 'Atrapamiento' is reserved for configuration entrapment — see that entry.
forbidden: atrapamiento (that is configuration entrapment — different rescue plan)

entries.note: Post-fall hanging in harness; rescue within minutes. Synonym crews may know: 'síndrome del arnés'.
NFPA 70E-es uses 'relámpago de arco' — accepted synonym. Arc-flash PPE = 'EPP contra arco eléctrico', includes 'ropa resistente a las llamas' (FR clothing).

entries.en: Immediately Dangerous to Life or Health (IDLH)
entries.es: inmediatamente peligroso para la vida o la salud (IDLH)
entries.note: NIOSH-es official expansion; keep IDLH acronym (atmo-check pairs it with SCBA/EVACUATE).
forbidden: IPVS (EU acronym — meters and docs here say IDLH)

entries.note: OSHA-es materials use casi/cuasi accidente; plain form chosen for 6th-grade level. Reporting must feel safe.
OSHA-es 1910.147 'Control de energía peligrosa (bloqueo/etiquetado)'. Mandated anchor. Expand on first use, then LOTO.
OSHA-es LOTO materials. Instruction form 'desenergice'. Switching off is not isolating stored energy.
forbidden: apagar (turn off only — leaves stored energy, unsafe)

entries.en: Tag "DO NOT USE" (tag out defective equipment)
entries.note: Usted imperative throughout: 'etiquete' for the action; tag text 'NO USE' keeps the same imperative register as NO OPERE / NO ENTRE, caps preserved. Pairs with 'FUERA DE SERVICIO' status.
forbidden: NO USAR (infinitive — caps prohibitions use usted imperative, like NO OPERE)

entries.note: OSHA-es welding pubs use 'vigilante de incendios' — accepted synonym; UI standardizes the full 'vigía de incendios', never bare 'vigía' (collides with the confined-space attendant when both roles are on the same job). Watch continues ≥30 min after hot work (NFPA 51B).
forbidden: vigía (bare — ambiguous with the confined-space attendant role)

entries.note: OSHA-es 1910.146: test before entry, in order O₂ → flammables → toxics.
'Monitoreo' is the LatAm form (confined-space form field).
No official OSHA-es equivalent; 'charla de seguridad (de 5 minutos)' is the pan-LatAm industry standard.
forbidden: charla de caja de herramientas (literal calque)

entries.es: firma de aceptación del plan (cuadrilla) / firma de aprobación
entries.note: Sign-on = the crew signs that they read and accept the plan's hazards and controls; sign-off = approving signature (visto bueno), e.g. 'Awaiting EHS manager sign-off' → 'en espera de la firma de aprobación del gerente de EHS'. Never 'ingreso': in field Spanish it means physically entering a site or confined space ('permiso de ingreso') and misreads as the entrant/entry record.
forbidden: firma de ingreso (reads as an entry/attendance record — dangerous role confusion with the confined-space entry log)
firma de enterado (acknowledged-only — downgrades approval, unsafe)

entries.note: OSHA-es 1910.146(k): plan non-entry retrieval first. 'Call 911' alone is not a rescue plan.
OSHA-es forklifts: examine 'antes de cada turno' (1910.178(q)(7)). Hour-meter field = 'lectura del horómetro' (never 'odómetro' = distance).
forbidden: inspección pre-viaje (calque — equipment, not a trip)

entries.note: Abrasive/grinding wheels (1910.215): tap the wheel and listen BEFORE mounting — a clear ring = sound wheel; a dull thud = cracked wheel, do not mount it. Named for the sound: 'anillo' has no acoustic sense in Spanish, so the calque loses the instruction.
forbidden: prueba de anillo (false-friend calque — anillo is only a ring-shaped object)

entries.note: OSHA-es 1910.212 'resguardos'. 'Guardas' is an accepted field synonym; UI uses resguardo. 'Machine Guarding Required' → 'Se requiere resguardo de máquinas'.
HazardTable/JHA column. Hierarchy of controls = 'jerarquía de controles'.
Permit lifecycle end; status Closed = 'cerrado'.

entries.en: Stop work / right to refuse unsafe work
entries.es: detenga el trabajo / derecho a rechazar trabajo inseguro
entries.note: OSHA-es workers'-rights materials. Anyone may stop work; keep it imperative and unconditional.
Emergency action plan term (1910.38-es). One mandated term for signage consistency.
forbidden: punto de encuentro (social register — keep one term)

entries.note: Keep PM acronym after expansion. 'PM Responsible Individual (DRI)' = 'responsable directo del mantenimiento preventivo (DRI)'.
forbidden: servicio (alone, for PM — vague; OK inside 'FUERA DE SERVICIO')

entries.note: OSHA-es 1910.151; eyewash per ANSI Z358.1 'estación lavaojos'.
OSHA-es official title (1926.501).
OSHA-es fall-protection materials; 5,000 lb (22.2 kN) per worker or engineered anchor.
Incident form. No-blame framing: analyze causes, never culprits — protects reporting culture.
forbidden: búsqueda de culpables (blame framing — kills reporting)

entries.es: acciones correctivas para evitar que se repita
entries.note: Plain 6th-grade phrasing of 'prevent recurrence'.
Builds on OSHA-es 'trabajo en caliente'; title case per UI style.
Builds on 'trabajo en altura'.

entries.es: permiso de entrada a espacio confinado
entries.note: OSHA-es 1910.146 entry permit; 'entrada' is the official term for entry.
OSHA pub 3138-es exact title. Determination step: 'determine si el espacio requiere permiso'.

entries.es: lista de verificación previa a la entrada
entries.note: Checklist = 'lista de verificación' app-wide (inspections, permits).
Daily crew-signature document. No OSHA-es equivalent; keep PTP code after expansion.

entries.es: análisis de peligros en el trabajo (JHA)
entries.note: OSHA 3071-es official title 'Análisis de peligros en el trabajo' — the 'en el' form is the mandated anchor. Crews may say AST/ATS (análisis de trabajo seguro) — oral synonym only. 'Hazard assessment' = 'evaluación de peligros'.
forbidden: análisis de peligros del trabajo (deviates from the OSHA 3071-es official form)
análisis de riesgos laborales (Spain PRL register)

entries.note: 'Reporte' is pan-LatAm (RAE Am.). Must sound routine, not punitive.
Permit timer (HotWorkPermitForm); plain time phrasing.
PTP/permit field.
EHS never expands and never substitutes to HSE/SSOMA (functional brand acronym — see doNotTranslate). Crews may know HSE/SSOMA — never substitute.
OSHA-es official (1926.32(f)): identifies hazards AND has authority to correct. Legally distinct from 'persona calificada' (qualified person).
LatAm 'calificado'. Trained (capacitado) is not the same as qualified.
Forklift/MEWP operator certified for that equipment.
OSHA 3138-es role. Plain 'supervisor' translates unchanged as 'supervisor'.

OSHA 3138-es uses 'asistente' — accepted synonym; UI standardizes 'vigía de espacio confinado' to avoid reading as 'assistant' and to distinguish from 'vigía de incendios' (fire watch) when both roles work the same job. Short form 'vigía' only inside unambiguous confined-space-only screens. The vigía never leaves the opening.
forbidden: vigía (bare, outside confined-space-only screens — collides with fire watch)

entries.note: OSHA 3138-es 'entrante autorizado'; short form 'entrante' where space-tight.
Safety ≠ security: bare 'seguridad' reads as guards. Use the full phrase.
forbidden: oficial de seguridad (anglicism; oficial = uniformed rank)

entries.note: Pan-LatAm work crew. In this app 'equipo' is reserved for equipment/machines — never use it for people.
forbidden: personal (alone, for people — vague; OK as the adjective inside 'equipo de protección personal' and 'sistema personal de detención de caídas')

entries.note: Maintenance document (WorkOrderCard).
forbidden: orden de servicio (different document in several countries)

entries.es: Programa de Prevención de Lesiones y Enfermedades (IIPP)
entries.note: Cal/OSHA official Spanish (T8 CCR §3203). Keep IIPP acronym.
forbidden: plan de prevención de riesgos laborales (Spain PRL)

entries.note: OSHA HazCom 1910.1200-es official. 'SDS Library' → 'biblioteca de SDS'. SDS acronym kept (GHS).
forbidden: ficha de datos de seguridad (EU/Spain FDS)

entries.note: OSHA-es topic page 'Montacargas' (1910.178); category label 'vehículos industriales motorizados (montacargas)'. 'Electric Sit-Down Forklift' → 'montacargas eléctrico de operador sentado'. In a few countries montacargas = freight elevator — context and photos disambiguate, matching OSHA-es usage.

entries.es: transpaleta eléctrica de operador a pie
entries.note: Manual version = 'transpaleta manual'. 'Transpaleta' is understood region-wide.
ANSI/ISO Spanish standards say PEMP, but UI keeps MEWP to match training records and labels; expand in Spanish on first use.
DESIGN.md OSHA-es anchor (scissor lift→elevador de tijera). 'Plataforma de tijera' accepted synonym in notes.
OSHA-es 1910.157 'extintores portátiles'. 'Extinguidor' (MX) is fine orally; UI standardizes extintor.
OSHA-es 1910.101. Chain upright, cap on when not in use.
OSHA-es fall-protection pubs alternate barandas/barandales; 'barandal' (MX) fine orally, UI uses barandas.
OSHA-es 1926.451 'andamios'. Mandated anchor term.
Equipment category label (equipment.ts); pairs with 'resguardo de máquinas'.

entries.en: Permit status: Active / Closed / Revoked / Expired
entries.es: estado del permiso: activo / cerrado / revocado / vencido
entries.note: 'Vencido' is the pan-LatAm word for expired documents/permits.

entries.en: Review status: Pending Review / Approved / Needs Revision / Recalled
entries.es: pendiente de revisión / aprobado / requiere correcciones / retirado
entries.note: 'Needs Revision' means changes requested — 'requiere correcciones' avoids the false friend 'revisión' (re-inspection). Recalled (by submitter) = 'retirado'.
forbidden: rechazado (as the Needs Revision status label — harsher than requested changes; the Deny action button 'Rechazar' is a different concept, see Approve / Deny; timeline note 'Rejected:' renders 'Rechazado:')
devuelto (as the bare status label; OK in prose such as 'devuelto por EHS para correcciones' when translating 'returned by EHS')
necesita revisión (false friend — sounds like inspection)

entries.en: Equipment status: Active / Retired / Pending Repair
entries.es: activo / dado de baja / reparación pendiente
entries.note: 'Dado de baja' = removed from the asset register; keeps 'retirado' reserved for recalled submissions.
Caps on tags and banners; pairs with the 'NO USE' tag.
Work orders/inspections past due. Keep distinct from 'vencido' (expired).
Inspection result banner (PreTripInspection).
Item-level inspection results; N/A expands once as 'no aplica', glyph 'N/A' kept.
forbidden: aprobado / reprobado (school register, as inspection item results only — 'aprobado' remains the mandated Approved review status and 'Aprobar' the Approve button)

entries.note: Inspection item flag; a failed safety-critical item forces DO NOT OPERATE.
'Falla' is the LatAm noun. Standalone 'Do not operate' = 'NO OPERE' (usted imperative, caps preserved).
forbidden: no operar (infinitive — instructions use usted imperative)

entries.en: Risk level: Critical / High / Medium / Low
entries.es: nivel de riesgo: crítico / alto / medio / bajo
entries.note: JHA/PTP risk matrix labels (RISK_LABELS map).
JHA column: the risk left AFTER controls are applied.
forbidden: riesgo aceptable (an acceptance decision, not the leftover risk)

entries.note: Incident field; OSHA-es materials use 'gravedad'.

entries.en: Atmospheric readings: O₂ % (19.5–23.5), LEL % (<10), CO, H₂S
entries.es: lecturas atmosféricas: % de O₂ (19.5–23.5), % de LEL (<10), CO, H₂S
entries.note: Decimal POINT as on gas meters and OSHA-es (19.5 %). LEL = 'límite inferior de explosividad' — expand once, keep LEL (meter display). Flammable exceedance = 'atmósfera explosiva'.
Atmo-check alarm state. Usted imperative, caps preserved, no courtesy words.

Atmo/work-stop alarm state. Usted imperative, caps. Always render the full form: bare 'ALTO' also means 'high' and can be misread as a HIGH gas reading or the risk level 'alto' on the same screen. If a short attention word is kept, only as 'ALTO — DETENGA EL TRABAJO', never bare 'ALTO' adjacent to gas readings or risk-level labels. 'PARE' is the South-American road-sign variant — oral only.
forbidden: ALTO (bare — also means 'high'; misread as a gas/risk-level label under stress)

entries.note: Confined-space gate state (atmo-check). Usted imperative, caps.
QR label print line; 'QR' stays untranslated; printed labels are bilingual EN/ES per DESIGN.md.
Buttons use infinitive (es-419 UI convention); instructions use usted imperative. Role 'Issuer' = 'emisor del permiso'.
Submit = 'enviar' app-wide.
Recall = take back for edits; keep 'revocar' reserved for permit revocation.
One verb per action app-wide: iniciar, enviar.
Review action buttons (review/action page). Deny ('Rechazar') sets the record to 'requiere correcciones' — see Review status; the status label itself never renders 'rechazado'.

entries.es: atrapamiento por la forma del espacio
entries.note: 1910.146 hazard: inwardly converging walls / downward-sloping floors that trap or asphyxiate. Owns 'atrapamiento' so Engulfment ('inmersión o sepultamiento...') stays distinct — the two hazards have different rescue plans.
forbidden: confinamiento (that is the space, not the hazard)

entries.es: vehículos industriales motorizados (montacargas) y equipo móvil
entries.note: Matches the PTP hazard row verbatim (src/data/safety-checklists.ts). 'Equipo móvil' covers the mobile-plant half; 'equipo' is reserved for machines in this glossary.
forbidden: planta móvil (false friend — 'planta' reads as factory/plant building)

entries.en: Hot work types: Welding / Cutting / Grinding / Brazing / Soldering / Torch (chips)
entries.es: soldadura (por arco/autógena) / corte / esmerilado / soldadura fuerte / soldadura blanda (estañado) / soplete
entries.note: HOT_WORK_TYPES multiselect chips render together — Welding, Brazing and Soldering must stay distinct on one screen: 'soldadura (por arco/autógena)', 'soldadura fuerte', 'soldadura blanda (estañado)'.
forbidden: soldadura (bare, as the label for more than one chip in the same list)
